description: This file contains functions for computing average precision metrics for object detection, including ap_per_class and compute_ap, based on YOLOv3 metrics.

methods.name: ap_per_class
methods.description: Calculates average precision, recall, and other metrics per class based on true positives, confidence scores, predicted classes, and target classes.

methods.name: compute_ap
methods.description: Computes average precision, precision curve, and recall curve from recall and precision lists.
